name: mirage
text:
Research done, no setting changed today. What the engine's own results say (2,290 settled orders since Oct 17):
- BIDS are making money: +$27.75 on $600 (+4.6%). Best: team totals +7.4%, 1st-half lines +10.4%, game totals +4.3%. Moneyline bids are negative but only 40 of them, so too few to act on.
- TAKER BETS (instant orders) are losing: -$72 on $1,218 (-5.9%). Tennis was the main leak and I tightened it on Oct 31. The remaining leak is non-tennis game totals and spreads: 194 bets, -15.5%, even though they listed +4.2% EV. A higher listed edge does not help; only 8+ books behind the fair helps, and that is still negative.
- Since the Oct 31 tightening only 75 taker bets have settled (+6.5%), too few to judge.
Why I didn't change anything: my rule needs 200 settled bets before cutting a bet type, and totals/spreads is at 194. Next run, if it is 200+ and still negative, I'll cut the engine's taker bets on those kinds (require 8+ books, or stop them). Bids stay as they are. Notes are in research/review/2026-11-01.md.
